sources.name: townofelizabeth.org
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: the site answers automated requests with 403, so there is nothing to read; checked by hand in a browser. Rechecked 10 November 2026 with a browser User-Agent: /, /events, /calendar, /rss.xml and the CivicPlus path /RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml all answered 403 (Cloudflare challenge). Only /robots.txt answered, and it is Drupal's stock file, so the site is Drupal, not CivicPlus, and the CivicPlus feed paths do not exist here. No feed could be found or read; still by hand.

sources.name: elizabethmainstreet.org
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Checked 10 November 2026: the Elizabeth Main Street Program's site (151 S Banner Street, 303-646-4166) is built on Locable. /events/ answered 200 and listed 'all 4 events', every one the monthly Elizabeth WIC Clinic at 651 Beverly Street (11 Nov, 9 Dec, 13 Jan, 10 Feb), so nothing listable in the next 30 days. No feed: /events/?ical=1 returns the same HTML page, /events.ics, /events.rss and /events/feed are 404, there is no Tribe API, and the page links no ics or rss. robots.txt allows everything but /carts/, /password/ and the like. locable.com's own copy of the listing answers 403 (Cloudflare). Stays html.

sources.name: pplibraries.org
sources.lastNote: robots.txt asks automated clients not to fetch it
sources.notes: Manual until the library answers: the activities page embeds five public Google calendars and this feedUrl is the one named 'Elizabeth Events' (647 events, 177 recurring, America/Denver), but calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows unlisted agents, and the editor is asking the library for permission before ingest reads it (docs/archive/emails/SOURCE-PERMISSION-EMAILS.md). Set type back to ical and robots to subscribe when it comes. Found 4 October 2026. Read once on 10 November 2026 to count: the feed answered 200 (text/calendar, 646 VEVENTs, calendar name 'Elizabeth Events'). 28 occurrences fall in the next 30 days under 13 titles; 19 of them are the standing regulars (Story Time 9, Yarning for All 4, Book Club 2, WIC Clinic 2, Community Coffee & Chat 2), leaving 9 occurrences of 8 one-off or monthly programs: Star Party with CSASTRO (14 Nov), Just a Note - Paper Arts, Curiosity Club, LEGO Construction Masters, Free Virtual Legal Clinic, Joy Seekers with Courtney, Heritage Crew, Piecemaker's quilting group. Two items carry no LOCATION, so defaultVenue is needed. robots.txt position unchanged: calendar.google.com's robots.txt is 'Allow: /$' then 'Disallow: /', so the .ics path is disallowed to an unlisted agent; type left manual until the library answers.

sources.name: pplibraries.org (District Happenings)
sources.notes: The second of the library's embedded Google calendars, 'District Happenings' (182 events across the branches); only items at Elizabeth would be taken. Same robots.txt position as pplibraries-org. Proposed 4 October 2026. Read 10 November 2026: 200, 182 VEVENTs, but only one occurrence in the next 30 days and it is at Elizabeth: Pines & Plains Board Meeting, 25 November, a routine meeting. So this feed would add next to nothing; the 'Elizabeth Events' calendar on pplibraries-org is the one that matters. The page's other three embedded calendars were read too and are other branches: 'Kiowa Events' (209 VEVENTs), 'Simla Events' (405), 'Elbert Events' (150); none has an Elizabeth location. Calendar.google.com's robots.txt is 'Allow: /$' then 'Disallow: /', so the .ics path is disallowed to an unlisted agent.

sources.name: The Elizabeth Brewing Company
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026: the brewery at 239 S Main Street, (720) 335-6011, on a GoDaddy Website Builder site. /upcoming-events answered 200 and describes regulars rather than dated events: Tuesday Night Trivia, the Wednesday 6 pm 'Tiny Tap' small-batch release, and the Friday Night Market in Running Creek Park, Fridays 5 to 9 pm June to August with live music, food trucks and vendors (/market-schedule holds the dates, not read). The page says dated events are on the brewery's Facebook page. No ics, rss or Google calendar in the page; no feed. Core because it is the one venue in town with a standing weekly programme and it runs the summer market; nothing dated in the next 30 days.

sources.name: Elbert County calendar (elbertcounty-co.gov)
sources.lastNote: feed answers, but robots.txt disallows it and it holds no Elizabeth event
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026: the county's site is CivicPlus and /iCalendar.aspx lists three feeds, 'Events' (catID=23), 'Community and Development' (26) and 'Meetings' (14). All three answered 200 as text/calendar: Events has 4 VEVENTs, 2 in the next 30 days, both office closures in Kiowa (Veterans Day, Thanksgiving); Community and Development has 1 (DP Ranch Rezone Community Meeting, 9 December, Kiowa); Meetings has 6, 3 in the window (County Commission, Planning Commission). Nothing in Elizabeth. The CivicPlus RSS (/RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&CID=All-calendar.xml) answered 200 with no items. robots.txt disallows both /common/modules/icalendar/ and /RSSFeed.aspx for every agent, so ingest would not read it under robots: honor. Recorded as manual with the feed URL kept for whoever asks the county; of no use to the Elizabeth calendar as it stands. The Elbert County Fair (elbertcountyfair.com, late July) is at the fairgrounds in Kiowa, not Elizabeth.

sources.name: Elizabeth School District calendar
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026: the district's site is Finalsite; /all-events is a month grid, readable a month at a time with ?cal_date=YYYY-MM-01 (both months answered 200). Public events in the next 30 days: EHS Craft Fair (Saturday 14 November, 9 am to 3 pm, Elizabeth High School, 34500 County Road 13), EMS Fall Musical (4 and 5 December), EMS/EHS Band Concert (7 December, at EHS), Combined Choir (8 December, at EHS), Combined Orchestra Concert (9 December, at EMS); six, beside board meetings, a parent night and school breaks. No feed ingest may read: robots.txt allows the page (Crawl-delay 5) and disallows /fs/, where Finalsite keeps its iCal export, the same position scripts/lib/finalsite-calendar.ts records for Berthoud. Read by hand.

sources.name: Elizabeth Stampede Rodeo
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026: the Stampede's own site (Squarespace). /upcoming-events is a Squarespace events list with a per-event ICS link; /upcoming-events?format=ical returns the HTML page, not a calendar, and robots.txt disallows ?format=json, so there is no collection feed. Nothing public in the next 30 days: the list holds a board meeting (12 November, virtual), the volunteers' Holiday Party (14 November) and a budget session (10 December). Earlier entries show what it carries in season: Community Rodeo (25 September 2026, Casey Jones Park), Royalty Competition. The rodeo itself is the first weekend of June. Seasonal; a look in spring is enough. The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: this page is in the list view, and scripts/lib/feeds/squarespace.ts read 3 items, none public (two board sessions and a members' party in Kiowa, all excluded); the rodeo and its events are posted here in spring from a plain fetch of it, which the site's robots.txt allows (it disallows ?format=json, ?view= and /api/, none of which the reader uses). Typed squarespace with the page as its feedUrl; still proposed, so ingest does not read it until the owner confirms it.

sources.name: marketspread.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Feed found 10 November 2026: the market's MarketSpread page carries a webcal link, and the same URL over https answered 200, text/calendar, calendar name 'Elbert County Marketplace', 99 VEVENTs back to 2022, each one market day with LOCATION '4189 CO-86, Elizabeth, CO 80107, USA' (Casey Jones Park) and no RRULE. Four fall in the next 30 days, the Saturdays 14, 21 and 28 November and 5 December, 9 am to 2 pm Mountain (times are UTC in the feed), all titled '2026 Season - Elbert County Marketplace'; the next after that is 19 December. marketspread.com's robots.txt is an empty Disallow, so the feed path is allowed. Type changed from html to ical; a weekly market, so the editor may prefer one recurring listing to four staged files. The market's own site, elbertcountymarketplace.com, answered 503 'Maintenance mode'. defaultVenue is the guide's own name for the place, Casey Jones Park Pavilion (10 November 2026): with the market's name there a dry run flagged a venue change on all five published market days.

sources.name: Elizabeth Kitchen + Bar (events calendar)
sources.defaultVenue: Elizabeth Kitchen + Bar, 240 S Elizabeth St, Unit 110
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The restaurant and bar at 240 S Elizabeth St, Unit 110, (720) 761-5000, already a place in the guide. Its site is GoDaddy Website Builder; /events is drawn by script, so the page source holds no events, and loaded in a browser it calls GoDaddy's calendar service, which answers the feedUrl as JSON ({events: [{title, desc, location, start, end, allDay}], timeZone: America/Denver}). Read once with curl: 200, 100 items from 9 November 2026 to 10 February 2027. Ingest cannot read this format yet (its json type is The Events Calendar only), so the type is manual and the feed is recorded for whoever writes a reader; until then the page is read by hand in a browser. Worth a row, 10 November to 10 December: 4. Snowman Porch Sign Painting with Sherry (Thursday 12 November, 6 to 8 pm), Live Music by Mike Maurer (Wednesday 25 November, 7 pm), Comedy Show (Saturday 5 December, 7:30 pm), Christmas Cow Painting with Sherry (Thursday 10 December, 6 pm). Just outside: New Year's Eve with live music by Raven-Wolf (31 December, 8 pm). Regulars in the window: 10 (Karaoke on Fridays 8 to 11 pm, four; Atom's Open Mic on alternate Sundays at 6 pm, two; Music VIDEO Bingo on the third Wednesday, one; Broncos games on the big screen, three). The rest of the feed is never-list: daily specials (Monday burger, half-off wine Wednesday, Thursday family night, weekend brunch, 65 of the 100 items), limited hours and closures. Items carry no location, so defaultVenue is needed. A disagreement to settle by hand: allevents.in (from the bar's Facebook events) lists 'Austin Allen Live' on Saturday 14 November, 7 to 10 pm, and 'Comedy Night Returns' on Saturday 12 December at 7 pm, neither of which is in this calendar, which has the comedy show on 5 December. robots.txt: elizabethkbar.com disallows only /404 (curl to the host was reset three times, so the site and its robots.txt were read with the fetch tool and Playwright); calendar.apps.secureserver.net has no robots.txt (404). No ics, rss or Google Calendar id is exposed, though one item's description carries Google Meet boilerplate, so the calendar is probably a Google calendar behind GoDaddy's widget.

sources.name: Legacy Academy (school public calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Legacy Academy is the K-8 charter school at 1975 Legacy Circle, Elizabeth (the address is on the feed's own items); the district calendar already in this registry does not carry its events. Its Finalsite home page links a public Google calendar, 'LA PUBLIC', and the feedUrl is that calendar's iCal address. Read once to count: 200, text/calendar, 5,394 VEVENTs back to 2017, 630 with a recurrence rule, times in UTC. Worth a row, 10 November to 10 December: 4. EVENT: PTCO Craft Fair (Saturday 14 November, 9 am), EVENT: Kinder-2nd Music + Piano & Guitar Concert (Tuesday 1 December, 6 pm), EVENT: 3rd-5th Grade Music & Choir Concert (Wednesday 2 December, 6 pm), EVENT: Fall Theater Performance (Thursday 3 December, 6 pm). The school prefixes its titles, and only 'EVENT:' items are candidates: about 45 other occurrences in the window are 'ATHLETICS:' (middle school basketball and cheer, mostly practices), 'CLUB:' (after-school clubs), 'FT' field trips, dress days, assemblies, the food drive, board meetings and no-school days, all never-list. The four EVENT items carry no LOCATION, so defaultVenue is needed. An editor may judge the two grade-level concerts to be parents' evenings and keep only the craft fair and the play. The excludeTitles here are fragments; a single regex entry '^(?!EVENT:)' would do the same job more tightly. robots.txt: legacyk8.org allows its pages (Crawl-delay 5, /fs/ disallowed); calendar.google.com is 'Allow: /$' then 'Disallow: /', so the .ics path is disallowed to an unlisted agent and this needs the editor's robots: subscribe, as the other guides' school calendars did. The craft fair is on the same Saturday as the EHS Craft Fair on the district calendar; they are two fairs at two schools.

sources.name: Elbert County Chamber of Commerce (events calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Elbert County Chamber of Commerce has its office at 338 S Main Street, Elizabeth (the address on its own orientation events) and most of what it lists is in Elizabeth. The elizabethchamber.org and elizabethkiwanis.org domains are parked and are not this. /events embeds a public Google calendar, 'ECCC Events Calendar (Website Only)'; the feedUrl is its iCal address. Read once to count: 200, text/calendar, 44 VEVENTs, 8 recurring. Worth a row, 10 November to 10 December: 0. The window holds only the chamber's own business: 1st Annual Member Appreciation Night (12 November, Spring Valley Golf Club, members), the monthly Business Over Beverages, Meet & Mingle and book club (third Tuesday and Wednesday), and Perk Up! networking (10 December, Catalina's Diner). It is recorded because through the year it does carry public days nobody else publishes as a feed: The Carriage Shoppes Christmas Open House (7 November 2026, 392 Main St), the 4th Annual Fall Fest & Movie in the Park (17 October, Evans Park), the ECCC Business Expo (25 April, Elizabeth High School), Town of Elizabeth Meet the Candidates (21 September), and, outside Elizabeth, Kiowa Fall Fest and Apples & Asses at Burro Base Camp (both 10 October); perhaps one or two a month in season. Some items are in Kiowa or Parker, so locationFilter keeps Elizabeth's. robots.txt: elbertcountychamber.org's is empty (200, no rules); calendar.google.com is 'Allow: /$' then 'Disallow: /', so the .ics path is disallowed to an unlisted agent and reading it weekly needs the editor's robots: subscribe. Low yield; turn on only if the networking exclusions hold.

sources.name: AllEvents, Elizabeth CO (aggregator of Facebook events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Not an organizer: an aggregator page that republishes public Facebook events located in Elizabeth, which is where this town's venues actually post (the brewery's own page says its dated events are on Facebook, and The Nest at the 1897 House has no website). Read once through the fetch tool; no feed was found or looked for beyond the page. It is a lead sheet for a person, never a source to publish from: every item needs checking with its organizer, and the page mixes in events from other states. In Elizabeth, 10 November to 10 December 2026, it listed about 10 worth a row: Veteran's Spaghetti Dinner (Friday 13 November, 5:30 to 7 pm, 155 W Kiowa Ave, Elizabeth Firefighters Community Foundation), Star Party with CSASTRO (14 November, the library, already known), EHS Craft Event (14 November, already known), Austin Allen Live at Elizabeth Kitchen + Bar (14 November, 7 to 10 pm), Watercolor Folk Christmas Cards (Sunday 15 November, 1 pm) and German Glitter Village (Sunday 22 November) at The Nest at the 1897 House, 286 S Main St, reservations (720) 643-5124, Connect, Create, & Grow: A Holiday Gathering (4 December, 39411 Congress Ln), Christmas at the Ranch (Saturday 5 December, 11 am to 3 pm, 36998 Timber Dr, organizer not named), and, just past the window, Comedy Night Returns at Elizabeth Kitchen + Bar (12 December), the High Plains Schutzhund Club Winter Trial (12 and 13 December, 34560 Cimarron Trl), Christmas Worship in the Barn (18 December, 36998 Timber Dr) and Santa plus gifts at American Legion Auxiliary Unit 82 (19 December). Regulars: Thursday Night Magic card nights at 210 S Elizabeth St Unit 104 (shop not identified) and the Elbert County Marketplace. Not on the page: the Mayor's Tree Lighting, Saturday 5 December 2026, 3 to 6 pm on Main Street with the lighting at 5, which a search result quotes from the Town's own page (townofelizabeth.org answers automated requests 403, so that page was not read). robots.txt allows the path for every agent and asks ClaudeBot for a crawl delay of 10 seconds.

sources.name: Elizabeth Celtic Festival
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The festival's own WordPress site; the home page answered 200 and still shows this year's dates, Saturday 18 July 2026, 9 am to 5 pm, and Sunday 19 July, 9 am to 4 pm (Casey Jones Park, by the press coverage; the home page text read here did not give the address): Scottish heavy athletics, pipe band and solo piping competitions, Highland dance, clans, living history, music, vendors, children 10 and under free. One event a year, so nothing dated 10 November to 10 December and no regulars; no calendar feed (the /feed/ is the blog's post RSS, not read). Seasonal: a look in spring for the 2027 dates is enough. robots.txt (read at www after the home page, because the bare host redirects) disallows only /wp-admin/. Beware elizabethcelticfestival.com, which is a different, hijacked domain showing unrelated content.

sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Elizabeth
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Elizabeth, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty. The reader (scripts/lib/feeds/eventbrite.ts) takes the first five pages, one every two seconds, and the location filter keeps what is in Elizabeth. Read that day: 100 events in five pages, 1 of them in town: Comedy Night in Elizabeth (2026-12-12, Elizabeth Kitchen + Bar). Eventbrite lists every organizer's events, so this is filed as other and its items wait for a person; classes and workshops are most of what a small town shows. robots.txt at www.eventbrite.com allows the page for ordinary agents (it disallows its internal /api/v3/destination/ search, which the reader does not use). Eventbrite's terms of service restrict automated collection of its pages; confirming this source is the owner's decision with that in mind. The event search API was shut in 2020, and the API that remains lists only the token holder's own events. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("for all towns as well use eventbrite"), told that Eventbrite's terms restrict automated collection and that robots.txt allows the page. Still filed as other: its items wait for a person. autoApprove from 10 November 2026, the owner's word ("auto publish all; having to manually do it would defeat the purpose of the town network setup"): its items publish under the standing rules, and one that may be an event already on the guide at that hour still waits. The title exclusions were widened the same day to what the guide never lists: professional trainings and association socials, partisan events, sales demonstrations, clinics' own workshops, app-run scavenger hunts and events in a private home.

sources.name: Bohemian Boys Comedy (its Eventbrite page)
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026 by reading all of the region's Eventbrite search (up to 49 pages), which the weekly read of five pages does not reach: this organizer had an event in Elizabeth. Its own page was read that day: 2 upcoming, 1 in town: Comedy Night in Elizabeth (2026-12-12). Confirmed with autoApprove on the owner's word that Eventbrite is used for every town and publishes without a person ("yes to 2 and auto publish all"); filed as other, kept to the town by the location filter, with the title exclusions every Eventbrite source carries. One page, read once a week. Eventbrite's terms of service restrict automated collection; see eventbrite-com-elizabeth.
